metadata.title: HPESimpliVity
metadata.description: The HPE SimpliVity PowerShell Module is used to manage and automate the HPE SimpliVity hyperconverged platform via a REST API. The module contains cmdlets to display information as well as execute common administrative tasks like perform backups/restores to SimpliVity and external datastores, move virtual machines, edit backup policies and create datastores.
